bodyHtml:
PART I.  GENERAL PROVISIONS

 

     §323D-1  Purpose.  The purpose of this chapter is to establish a health planning and resources development program to promote accessibility for all the people of the State to quality health care services at reasonable cost. [L 1975, c 159, pt of §2; ree L 1977, c 178, pt of §2; am L 1987, c 270, §3]
